concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-paypal-web-component-express-checkout]] — 2026-09-15-captured PayPal Web Component v5.59.0+ Express guide for Sessions/Advanced order updates, latest paymentData, Advanced-only review and token exceptions; examples and 2023 metadata conflict need qualification.
warnings: The 2023 last-modified metadata conflicts with a linked 2024 v5.59.0 release; retain capture date and version prerequisite without inferring historical availability.
Sessions updateOrder uses sessionId, Advanced uses pspReference; both require latest paymentData. Sessions cannot use the extra review page.
The /payments/details samples are malformed JSON, and Go v10.4.0-labeled imports use /v9/ paths; snippets are not verified implementations.
Broad no-action-if-amount-unchanged wording coexists with an initial update-order callback on PayPal lightbox open.
